correctness.rationale: Reconstructed transfer matrix T=J_q−I_q and its b=q−1,−1 eigenvalues, the marked-color covariance a(r^d+r^{n−d}+c), and cyclic Green inverse L G=hI. Sherman–Morrison gives Q exactly. The Fourier-mode eigenvalues are positive except g+nc=0 at precisely n=q=3; b^n≥n(b+1)−1 proves this unique singularity. Neighbor entries have strict positivity by the explicit n-even inequality; all nonneighbor signs follow from c=(b−1)(−1/b)^n. Exact independent direct enumeration for q=3,4,5, n=3..6 and a rational Gauss–Jordan inverse checked 249 nonexceptional matrix entries.
residual_risks: n,q integers at least 3; one marked color, uniform proper colorings, linear partial correlations only; singular three-color triangle.
Finite computations and source package self-checks do not establish infinite quantifiers; reconstructed proof supplies those claims.

originality.rationale: The exact transfer-matrix two-point function is old Potts-model mathematics, but its one-marked-color finite-cycle inverse covariance has nonzero all-nonneighbor entries with parity-dependent signs and a unique singular triangle. Primary cyclic-strip zero-temperature partition treatments and multi-site Potts two-point work do not state this exact inverse matrix/linear partial-correlation classification. Other Resultary precision findings concern different observables. A hidden equivalent in earlier graphical-model literature remains possible.
residual_risks: An older exact inverse for the antiferromagnetic one-dimensional Potts Green matrix may be implicit in the literature, even if not indexed as precision.
This is only linear partial correlation of a non-Gaussian model, not actual conditional independence.

value.rationale: The marked-color indicator is a natural observation of the proper-coloring model; its precision matrix reveals exact, very weak but nonzero all-to-all linear dependence whose sign flips with cycle parity. A complete uniform n,q formula, unique singular boundary and strict sign classification are a motivated finite-graph structural theorem, not an arbitrary small table. No claim about nonlinear conditional independence.

Value is scoped to the precise object and stated invariant, not an invented general downstream theorem.
